payload.reason: Reference fixture: corpus is the fixture itself; no external surface to probe. Inventory is attested by construction.

payload.title: Render typed-artifact frontmatter in fixed field order
alternatives_considered: Emit frontmatter in event-insertion order (rejected: non-deterministic across renderers)
Sort all frontmatter keys alphabetically (rejected: structural-minimum order is load-bearing for readers)
payload.rationale: A fixed structural-minimum order followed by schema fields is the only rule under which two independent renderers agree byte-for-byte, which is the property the fixture pins.
constraints_imposed: Every artifact projection in this workspace renders id, kind, created_at, hash, confidence, reverses, superseded_by, tags first.
payload.body: The decision fixes projection frontmatter ordering so the golden fixture has a single canonical byte sequence per artifact.

payload.title: Byte-identical projection rendering is testable, not merely assertable
payload.evidence: This workspace: regenerating any projection from events.jsonl reproduces the bytes recorded in hashes.json; hw verify reports zero projection_drift. Anchored by [DEC-001#50b5472bf5fc].
implications: A renderer that diverges from [DEC-001#50b5472bf5fc] produces projection_drift, so the promise is enforced by replay, not by trust.
payload.body: The finding records that the rendering promise of core/TYPED-ARTIFACTS.md is now checkable against a fixed reference, consuming [DEC-001#50b5472bf5fc] as its anchor.
